status: PREVIEW ONLY - not a runtime scenery revision
scope: Private-aircraft canopy pull-through only. BBJ2 is excluded from the forward-turn requirement by the user.

proposal.operations: Enter from north, stop south-facing beside the terminal, depart forward through a right-turn loop west back to the main taxi spine. BBJ2 tow-in/tow-out retained.
proposal.marshaller: Keep the current marshaller at [2648,286]; calibrate the revised stand stop in the future build. Do not place equipment in the turning sweep.
proposal.paint: Yellow guide in the future build. Blue/amber in this preview distinguish arrival/departure only.

Lineage 1000E.note: Conservative full rectangle plus 0.10 m numerical buffer. Wheelbase and nose datum are planning assumptions; not simulator acceptance.

G650.note: Conservative full rectangle plus 0.10 m numerical buffer. Wheelbase and nose datum are planning assumptions; not simulator acceptance.

method.model: Kinematic bicycle model integrated along the nosewheel path; aircraft body heading is not simply the line tangent.
method.reference_radius_explanation: 10 m is the representative main-gear turning radius, not a 10 m painted nosewheel arc.
method.collision_shape: Full length by full wingspan rectangle, deliberately broader than an aircraft silhouette.
method.excluded: Add-on steering limits and tire slip, moving vehicles, jet blast, passengers during aircraft movement, tug physics and live OpenSAM stop behavior.

sources.title: Gulfstream G650ER product sheet, exterior dimensions (G650 family)
Embraer Lineage 1000E dimensions, manufacturer product table
Embraer E190 Airport Planning Manual, ground maneuvering methodology; E190 reference, not a Lineage add-on validation

accepted_scope: Offline concept geometry only; test G650/Lineage in X-Plane before calling the loop usable.
